# STADIUM-DT dataset

Everything here is **synthetic**. Nothing was measured at Beaver Stadium or any real venue; zone, gate and section labels are illustrative.

## Part 1 - `synthetic_game_day/` (generated by running the testbed) - version 2

One simulated game day, 18:30-22:59, sampled every 60 s, produced by running the demo's own model headlessly (`tools/generate-dataset.js`). Gates open 18:00, kick-off 19:30, halftime 20:52-21:12, final whistle 22:34. The model advances in 0.5 s steps; sensors are fused every second; alert rules run every 2 s.

Two segments (column `segment`):
- `A_continuous_18:30-22:33`: initialised at 18:30 (the testbed integrates from gate opening at 18:00) and run continuously.
- `B_postgame_reinit_22:34`: re-initialised at the final whistle with the seated catchment released, exactly as the testbed does when the POST-GAME phase is selected. Needed because a continuous run does not start post-game egress by itself. The concourse state jumps at 22:34 (about 216 -> 20 people) because of this re-initialisation.

| File | Rows | One row = |
|---|---|---|
| zones.csv | 2,700 | one concourse zone at one minute (10 zones x 270 min) |
| gates.csv | 1,080 | one gate (A-D) at one minute |
| amenities.csv | 1,080 | one concession/restroom at one minute |
| events.csv | 191 | one alert, forecast or clearing event (time-stamped to the second) |

**zones.csv**: `time`, `phase`, `segment`, `zone_id`, `area_m2` (walkable area), `true_people` (simulator ground truth; not observable in real life), `estimated_people` (twin's fused estimate), `density_ppm2` (estimated people per m^2, unrounded estimate / area), `density_level` (LOW <1.5, MODERATE <2.5, ELEVATED <3.5, HIGH >=3.5), `speed_mps`, `flow_direction`, `inflow_per_min`, `outflow_per_min`, `amenity_queue`, `confidence` (0.25-0.97), `weight_cctv` / `weight_wifi` / `weight_model` (share of each input in the fused estimate; sum to 1 within rounding).

**gates.csv**: `gate`, `open`, `throughput_per_min` (screened entries), `queue_people`, `confidence`.

**amenities.csv**: `amenity` (CONC_A/B concessions, REST_A/B restrooms), `type`, `queue_people`, `queue_capacity`, `confidence`.

**events.csv**: `time`, `segment`, `category` (alert / predict), `text`.

Ground truth uses the testbed's nominal parameters (no perturbations); sensors carry the testbed's synthetic error models. Raw per-sensor readings are not stored by the testbed and are not included. Version 1 (sent earlier) lacked post-game egress and used 1 s steps; it is superseded.

## Part 2 - `paper_results/` (results reported in the manuscript)

Machine-readable copies of the result and configuration tables of the STADIUM-DT manuscript (R2; same values as the IEEE version). Values were extracted programmatically from the manuscript tables and not recomputed. Combined cells ("a / b / c") were split into tidy long format.

| File | Source | Content |
|---|---|---|
| E1_fusion_accuracy.csv | R2 Table 10 / IEEE Table IV(A) | MAPE, 95% interval coverage, lag by prior, sources, window |
| E2_forecast_accuracy.csv | R2 Table 11 / IEEE Table IV(C) | density MAE, skill, threshold-event F1, ETA error by method |
| E3_detection.csv | R2 Table 12 / IEEE Table IV(B) | detections of 19 episodes, latency, false alarms by alarm rule |
| E4a_single_requests.csv | R2 Table 13 / IEEE Table V(A) | crowd-aware vs shortest recommendations by destination |
| E4b_burst_requests_K120.csv | R2 Table 14 / IEEE Table V(B) | burst of 120 group requests: time and concentration by policy |
| E5_E6_scenarios.csv | R2 Table 15 / IEEE Table V(C) | intervention effects: nominal, parameter draws, Weidmann relation |
| E7_compute_cost.csv | R2 Table 16 / Supplement Table S5 | run time of twin functions |
| scenario_definitions.csv | R2 Table 9 / Supplement Table S4 | the nine what-if scenarios |
| ground_truth_perturbations.csv | R2 Table 7 / Supplement Table S3 | perturbation distributions per replicate |
| boundary_messages.csv | R2 Table 3 / Supplement Table S1 | messages crossing the aggregate-only boundary |
| validation_targets.csv | R2 Table 18 / IEEE Table VI | proposal targets vs evidence |

These are summary statistics (means over seeds, pooled counts). The per-seed raw outputs of experiments E1-E7 come from the author's experiment harness and supplementary archive and are not part of this package. Three reported values are flagged for author confirmation (TWIN_IR skill 0.73; pilot-only feedback gains 2.5%/2.7%; real-time factor 2,768) - see Supplement Section S4.2.

## Regenerating

`npm install && npm run generate-data` (from the repository root) reruns the demo's model headlessly with `tools/three-stub.js` in place of three.js and writes fresh CSV files to `data/generated/`. The ground truth (`true_people`, queues) reproduces exactly; the simulated sensor noise can differ slightly because the page draws random numbers while loading. The shipped files in `synthetic_game_day/` are the ones described in `docs/dataset-descriptor.pdf`.
